name: Portfolio Website
text:
This website was made to double as both showcase and functional portfolio.  I designed it to stand out from the crowd of single-page scrolling Bootstrap sites while using a minimalist color palette.  While it lacks some of the flash of fancily-animated portfolio sites, I was aiming to have its simplicity speak loudest.

Through a series of iterative changes, I slimmed this site down from its original version and added features that I intended to enhance the user experience.
